items.title: 61520_Teddy Edwards oral history interview
items.q: They had Al Haig on piano... So we hooked up again. Charlie Parker and the band... we would manage to get together in the after-hour spots

ctx.x: And a little later on, they did some alterations in the place and moved the bandstand on the other side of the wall.

In the meantime, this is just about the time when Dizzy Gillespie and Charlie Parker came to work for Billy Berg's with their fine group. They had Al Haig on piano, Stan Levey playing the drums, Ray Brown on bass, and Milt Jackson playing the vibes -- and later on, they added Lucky Thompson. So we hooked up again. Charlie Parker and the band, they were living at the Downtown House and I was still living at the Civic -- we were less than a half-a-block apart, you know. So we would manage to get together in the…
